question: Should ResizableDivider automatically emit vibration feedback and transient keyboard hints as default Control UI behavior?
rationale: These are new sensory and discoverability policies rather than a mechanical repair, and current shipped behavior already provides keyboard, pointer, focus, and ARIA accessibility.

options.title: Narrow the interaction change
options.body: Split out the theme toggle and keep only proven divider visual and accessibility improvements, excluding automatic vibration unless separately approved.

options.title: Accept the complete design
options.body: Keep hints, announcements, and vibration together after the contributor supplies real browser, screen-reader, and mobile-device proof.

options.title: Retain shipped behavior
options.body: Close the PR if the added visual and sensory complexity is not desirable beyond the existing accessible divider implementation.

recommendation.title: Narrow the interaction change
recommendation.body: Split out the theme toggle and keep only proven divider visual and accessibility improvements, excluding automatic vibration unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The release history identifies BunsDev with the divider's existing accessible interaction design.
